food_prep.rationale: Private-household cook; institutional cook and food-prep-worker fallbacks where suppressed.

laundry.rationale: Laundry and dry-cleaning workers; housekeeping fallback.

maintenance.rationale: Maintenance and repair workers, general (incl. vehicle/appliance upkeep by household member).

management.rationale: Office clerks, general — planning, mail, bills; conservative vs. financial-manager rates (see methodology).

shopping.rationale: Generalist rate for purchasing goods/services for the household.

childcare_edu.rationale: Childcare workers; teaching-assistant fallback for education-related help.

adult_care.rationale: Home health & personal care aides (2018 SOC broad/detailed).

hh_travel.rationale: Household-related travel priced at generalist rate.
